toc.value: Cup matches — pure drama (3 wins from 3!)

frontMatter.title: Busy Week: 10 Matches, Big League Wins & 3 Cup Victories
frontMatter.summary: A huge week with 10 matches played: standout league wins across Mixed and Ladies teams, two hard-fought Grade 2 Mixed draws, and three dramatic cup victories including two 7–5 thrillers. Another 11 matches await next week.

prev.title: Beginners & Improvers Badminton Course — Now Open
prev.summary: Join our 10-week Beginners & Improvers Badminton Course starting Wednesday 18th February at St Paul’s National School, Navan—no experience needed.

next.title: Monday Club Night at Claremont
next.summary: Two home matches at Claremont—Navan 'A' vs Kildalkey (Grade 2 Mixed) and Navan vs Drumree (Grade 7 Mens) — plus member courts from 9pm and Juvenile Club Night from 6:30pm.
